# Institutional Trading Handbook

Welcome to the official **TradersDesk Quantitative Framework Guide**. This handbook explains how our mathematical models, real-time market breadth, and options analytics operate.

---

## 1. Market Breadth Dynamics

Market breadth measures the underlying participation of scrips in an index move. While market-cap weighted indices can be manipulated by 2 or 3 heavyweights, true institutional accumulation is revealed only when broader constituents advance.

- **X-Column Dominance**: Advancing stocks with bullish PnF breakout signals.
- **O-Column Dominance**: Decliners registering support breaks.
- **20 SMA Crosses**: Leading signals for sustained intraday trend extensions.

---

## 2. Cash Delivery vs F&O Buildup

When Price rises accompanied by high cash delivery volume, it indicates genuine institutional absorption rather than temporary speculative leverage.

| Signal Type | Delivery % | Futures OI | Institutional Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Genuine Longs | > 60% | Increasing | Long-term institutional accumulation |
| Short Covering | < 30% | Decreasing | Speculative bears squaring off |
| Strong Bearish | > 60% | Increasing | Heavy institutional distribution |

---

## 3. Options Greek Calibration

All Black-Scholes valuations in TradersDesk are calibrated with continuous trading-minute time decay and live implied volatility surfaces across Upstox and Angel One real exchange feeds.
